title: Future Tense 2: Imperfective Future (буду + infinitive)
description: The imperfective future tense in Russian: буду / будешь / будет / будем / будете / будут + the imperfective infinitive. Two-word future for processes, habits, and ongoing actions.
descriptionRussian: Имперфективное будущее: спрягается буду по лицам и числам и добавляется имперфективный инфинитив.
intro: English has one future and Russian has two, which is the thing to get used to. This is the first of them: буду plus an infinitive, built exactly like 'I will be reading' rather than 'I will read'. It covers things you will be doing rather than things you will get done. The other future arrives in lesson 3, and lesson 4 is about choosing.
rules: Imperfective future formation: conjugate буду (буду / будешь / будет / будем / будете / будут) and add the imperfective infinitive.
The auxiliary буду is the future of быть; the same forms also serve as the future-tense auxiliary for imperfective verbs.
The infinitive after буду MUST be imperfective. A perfective infinitive after буду is ungrammatical (use the one-word perfective future instead, taught in Lesson 3).
The imperfective future expresses ongoing process or habitual action, not a single completed result. 'Завтра я буду читать' = 'tomorrow I'll be reading', not 'tomorrow I will have read'.
examples: Я буду читать книгу. (I will be reading the book.) Process: ongoing reading.
Антон будет работать в Москве. (Anton will work in Moscow.) Habit: a continuing job.
Маша будет гулять каждый день. (Masha will walk every day.) Habit: recurring activity.
Мы будем говорить об этом. (We will talk about this.) Process: ongoing conversation.
У меня будет новая машина. (I will have a new car.) Будет alone, expressing 'will have'.
Завтра будет холодно. (Tomorrow it will be cold.) Будет alone in an impersonal phrase.

tables.title: Three Verbs in the Imperfective Future

items.promptEnglish: Tomorrow I will be in Moscow.
items.hint: Recap from Lesson 1: the future of быть, 1st person singular.
items.explanation: Recap from Lesson 1. With я, the future of быть is буду: я буду в Москве. Today's drill, starting Q1.2, puts these same forms to work as the auxiliary of the imperfective future (буду + impf inf).

items.promptEnglish: Tomorrow I will be reading the book.
items.explanation: 1sg. The imperfective future for 'я' uses 'буду' + impf inf. So 'я буду читать'. The same construction can mean 'I will read' or 'I will be reading' depending on context.
3sg. The imperfective future for 'она' or any 3sg subject uses 'будет' + impf inf. So 'Маша будет работать'. The auxiliary marks the person; the infinitive does not change.
1pl. The imperfective future for 'мы' uses 'будем' + impf inf. The 'каждый день' cue is a classic imperfective trigger (habit / repetition); the construction matches the meaning.

items.promptEnglish: They will be talking about the film.
items.explanation: 3pl. The imperfective future for 'они' uses 'будут' + impf inf. So 'они будут говорить'. Note 'говорить' is imperfective; its perfective partner 'сказать' would NOT pair with будут (Lesson 3 will teach the perfective future).

items.promptEnglish: What will you (formal) be doing this evening?
items.hint: 2pl / formal ('вы'). Which form of буду matches?
items.explanation: 2pl or formal-singular ('вы'). The imperfective future uses 'будете' + impf inf. The same form covers a group of listeners or one person addressed formally.

items.promptEnglish: Tomorrow I will be reading the book all evening.
items.hint: 'Весь вечер' is a duration. Which future construction fits a process?
items.explanation: A duration (весь вечер) calls for the imperfective future: буду + imperfective infinitive = буду читать.

items.promptEnglish: Anton will be working in Moscow in the summer.
items.hint: An ongoing summer job. Which construction?
items.explanation: An ongoing state takes the imperfective future: будет работать. After будет, the verb stays in the infinitive.

items.promptEnglish: Masha will walk in the park every day.
items.hint: 'Каждый день' is a habit cue. Which future?
items.explanation: A repeated future habit (каждый день) takes the imperfective future: будет гулять.

blanks: Антон _____ играть в шахматы каждый вечер. (Anton will play chess every evening.)
fillInBlank.grammarFocus: Антон is 3sg, so the imperfective future uses будет + impf inf. The 'каждый вечер' cue confirms the imperfective reading: a recurring habit, not a single completed event.

errorCorrection.sentence: Завтра ты буду отдыхать весь день.
errorCorrection.translationEnglish: Tomorrow you will rest all day.
errorCorrection.explanation: The auxiliary conjugates by person: я буду, ты будешь, он/она будет, мы будем, вы будете, они будут. Ты is 2sg, so the form is будешь. The two-word imperfective future puts the person marking on the auxiliary, never on the infinitive.

errorCorrection.sentence: Я буду работаю в Москве летом.
errorCorrection.translationEnglish: I will work in Moscow this summer.
errorCorrection.explanation: After буду, the second verb must be in the infinitive, not a conjugated present-tense form. The auxiliary already marks person and tense; the infinitive supplies the lexical meaning. Работаю is the 1sg present and cannot follow буду: the construction is strictly буду + infinitive.

minimalPairs.explanation: Я is 1sg, so the auxiliary is буду. Будешь would be required for 2sg ('ты будешь читать').
Они is 3pl, so the auxiliary is будут. Будет would be required for 3sg ('он будет работать').

reviewVocab.definition: future tense (Russian splits it by aspect: imperfective uses буду + impf inf, perfective uses a synthetic conjugation taught in Lesson 3)
reviewVocab.example: В предложении 'Я буду читать книгу' слова 'буду читать' выражают будущее время имперфективного вида.

reviewVocab.definition: imperfective future (the construction буду + imperfective infinitive; expresses process or habit)
reviewVocab.example: В предложении 'Маша будет работать в Москве' конструкция 'будет работать' — имперфективное будущее.

reviewVocab.definition: auxiliary verb (the conjugated form of быть that pairs with the imperfective infinitive in the future)
reviewVocab.example: В будущем времени 'буду / будешь / будет' — это вспомогательный глагол; основное действие выражает инфинитив.
